description: National Medicines Regulatory Authority - Medicines (Pricing Mechanism for Medicines) Regulations No. 02 of 2025.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, establishing a pricing mechanism for medicines. It creates legal/regulatory frameworks for maximum retail prices and maximum ceiling prices, specifies calculation formulas, and outlines enforcement provisions including penalties for contravention. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it establishes binding regulatory requirements under existing legislation.
